# Graph operations · model

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### model.compare

Compare procedural prefab identities and report retained, added, removed, split and conflicting members.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `before` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `after` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `kind` | `string` | `"visual"` | {"choices":["visual","world"]} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Guides: [guide](../procedural.md#stable-identities-for-generated-parts)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe model.compare --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### model.prefab

Collect keyed group outputs into a revisioned visual or world prefab with stable member IDs.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `model` | `string` | Required |  |
| Input | `revision` | `number` | Required | {"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Input | `sections` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `base` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `kind` | `string` | `"visual"` | {"choices":["visual","world"]} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Guides: [guide](../procedural.md#stable-identities-for-generated-parts)
